capabilities.description: Free Apple-ecosystem reminders app; automatable on-device via Shortcuts / Siri / EventKit.

usage_terms.notes: No developer cloud API. On-device automation only via Shortcuts/Siri/EventKit; requires an agent resident on the user's Apple device.

provenance.notes: Verified 2026-06: free, Apple-only, local-only invocation. System app (no store rating). Training stance not specifically documented -> unknown.

data_governance.lock_in_notes: Apple ecosystem; data in iCloud. Apple's general posture is on-device privacy, but no Reminders-specific training statement was verified.
